newsitem.title: USA: Tech Electro to sell 1.1 mln shrs privately.
newsitem.headline: Tech Electro to sell 1.1 mln shrs privately.

text.p: Tech Electro Industries Inc said Wedneday it has signed a letter of intent to sell privately to Asian investors 1.1 million shares of common stock and three-year options to purchase an additional one million shares for $1.87 million.
The company said the options are exercisable at $2.15 per share. The deal is expected to close in December.
Currently, there are 1,308,275 common shares outstanding, the company said.
Tech Electro imports, distributes and sells electronic components used in to manufacture and assemble high-technology products, such as computers and oil field equipment.
